set -e; EXPECTED=78b41c0e3eddaa82b69a846b03ceb4db2483e312; git fetch origin work/phase1-live-call-probes; git checkout work/phase1-live-call-probes; git reset --hard origin/work/phase1-live-call-probes; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/tmp/aicall-cycle20-device-sampler-v2.tsv')
print('sampler_exists=', p.exists())
rows=[]
if p.exists():
    for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
        s=line.split()
        if len(s)==9:
            rows.append((float(s[0]),)+tuple(int(x or 0) for x in s[1:]))
app=[r for r in rows if r[1]>0]
helper=[r for r in rows if r[5]>0]
print('device_samples=',len(rows),'app_samples=',len(app),'helper_samples=',len(helper))
if app:
    print('app_pid_count=',len({r[1] for r in app}))
    print('app_rss=',app[0][2],app[-1][2],max(r[2] for r in app))
    print('app_fd=',app[0][3],app[-1][3],max(r[3] for r in app))
    print('app_threads=',app[0][4],app[-1][4],max(r[4] for r in app))
if helper:
    print('helper_pid_count=',len({r[5] for r in helper}))
    print('helper_rss=',helper[0][6],helper[-1][6],max(r[6] for r in helper))
    print('helper_fd=',helper[0][7],helper[-1][7],max(r[7] for r in helper))
    print('helper_threads=',helper[0][8],helper[-1][8],max(r[8] for r in helper))
PY
echo '=== cycle result markers ==='; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J logcat -d -v raw -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S' 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'completed_cycles=|first_failed_cycle=|service_pid_stable=|final_prepared=|final_active=|final_heartbeat=|cycle_probe_ok=' | tail -n 20 || true; echo '=== current state ==='; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial RFCT70L7E8J status; echo bluetooth_on=$(adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')
